style.styleTitle: Dibor Leaves Pre-Lit String Christmas Decoration
style.toneOfVoice: A simple, yet stylish decoration that s brimming with minimalist charm, this pre lit garland is crafted from delicate golden leaves interwoven with fairy lights. The slim string garland is encased in a shimmering cover that will pair beautifully with both contemporary and traditional seasonal décor with ease. Warm white LED lights are woven throughout each garland to fill your room with a warm and cosy glow that s sure to brighten up those cold winter evenings. Just the thing for creating a welcoming atmosphere for your family and guests. The leaf garland can be draped over the mantelpiece, wound around your staircase or Christmas tree, or even as a subtle and elegant dining table centrepiece that s sure to impress. Requires 3x AA batteries (not included). L200cm Size: ONE.
